title: A Direct Route to Markov Chain Convergence via Asymptotic Equivalence with the Target
abstract: arXiv:2608.03353v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: For a Markov kernel $T$ with an invariant probability measure $\pi$, we give a self-contained proof of the Markov chain convergence theorem via a criterion called asymptotic equivalence with the target. It assumes two parts about the Lebesgue decompositions of $T^n_x$ and $\pi$ for every starting point $x$: 1.) asymptotic absolute continuity: the singular mass $\mathrm{sing}(T^n_x \mid \pi)$ tends to $0$; and, 2.) asymptotic domination of the target: the singular mass $\mathrm{sing}(\pi \mid T^n_x)$ tends to $0$, as $n \to \infty$. Assuming a jointly measurable density for the absolutely continuous part of each iterate $T^n$ w.r.t. $\pi$, this criterion is sufficient and necessary for convergence. A positive minorant density version of it is verified in three cases: i.) $T$ has a positive transition density w.r.t. $\pi$; ii.) $T$ consists of an absolutely continuous part with positive transition density together with an atom at

translated_title: 通过目标渐近等价实现马尔可夫链收敛的直接途径
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.03353v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：对于具有不变概率测度π的马尔可夫核T，我们通过一个称为“与目标渐近等价”的准则，给出了马尔可夫链收敛定理的自包含证明。该准则假设对于每个起始点x，T^n_x和π的勒贝格分解满足两个条件：1.) 渐近绝对连续性：奇异质量sing(T^n_x | π)趋于0；以及2.) 目标的渐近支配：奇异质量sing(π | T^n_x)趋于0，当n趋于无穷时。假设每个迭代T^n相对于π的绝对连续部分具有联合可测密度，该准则对于收敛是充分且必要的。其正小量密度版本在三种情况下得到验证：i.) T相对于π具有正转移密度；ii.) T由具有正转移密度的绝对连续部分以及一个原子部分组成。
tldr: 本文提出并证明了一种基于与目标测度渐近等价的充分必要条件，用于判断马尔可夫链的收敛性，并在多种典型场景下验证了该准则的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces and proves a sufficient and necessary criterion for Markov chain convergence based on asymptotic equivalence with the target measure, and validates it in several typical scenarios.
